newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Westpac leads A$50 mln fungible for BOS Intl.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Westpac leads A$50 mln fungible for BOS Intl.

text.p: Westpac Banking Corp said it has lead managed a A$50 million bond issue for BOS International (Australia) Ltd, which will be fungible with a 6.5 percent November 2001 offering made in January.
The guarantor is the Bank of Scotland.
This new offering, which is rated A plus by Standard & Poor's, would bring the total issue size to A$100 million.

The issue would be made under the issuer's A$1.0 billion Commercial Paper and Medium Term Note Programme, and would be priced on Thursday over the 12.0 percent November 2001 government benchmark bond, Westpac said.
The fixed margin reoffer price would be 31 basis points over benchmark. Settlement would be February 18, it added.
